gap: A gap in the field, with no unit

walkingOrder.title: Walking order
walkingOrder.description: How measurers walk the field. Every phone receives it when a session starts.

byRow.label: By row
byRow.description: Walks the layout row by row. Rows measured late in the day differ in light and heat from rows measured early.

serpentine.label: Serpentine
serpentine.description: Walks row by row and turns back at each row end. It saves walking but keeps the time-of-day risk of by row.

randomByBlock.label: Random by block
randomByBlock.description: Shuffles the plots within each block from a seed. Time of day no longer follows the layout inside a block.

treatmentBalanced.label: Treatment-balanced
treatmentBalanced.description: Spreads every treatment evenly across the walk from a seed. No treatment is measured mostly early or mostly late.

walkingOrder.balance: Every {{window}} plots in a row hold each treatment {{expected}} times, give or take one
walkingOrder.unbalanced: Part of the walk holds a treatment more often than the balance allows

divide.title: Divide the field
divide.description: Give each measurer a share of the walking order. Each share becomes the assignment their phone receives.

splits.equalShares: Equal shares along the walking order

splitHints.equalShares: Or row bands, which keep every block with one measurer.
splitHints.rowBands: Or equal shares, which cut the walking order into even parts.

divide.paintHint: Pick a measurer, then click or drag over plots to move them into that share.
divide.oneTreatmentWarning: A share of one treatment ties this measurer to that treatment.
divide.noOverlap: No plot is in two shares.

overview.title: Sessions ended today
overview.summary: {{readings}} received from {{phones}}. {{covered}} of {{total}} plots covered, {{skipped}} skipped, {{repeats}}, {{offPlan}} off-plan.
overview.measuredTwiceHint: {{plots}} hold readings from two phones. A person decides which reading stands.

review.title: Needs review
review.description: Plots that two phones both measured. Decide which reading stands.
review.explanation: Two phones measured {{plot}} and nobody asked for a repeat.
